mapping_review_rationale: USDA table reports explicit (-)-Epigallocatechin 3-gallate; matched to the stereospecific (-)-epigallocatechin gallate alias in the single Stage B EGCG record. Name punctuation normalized by documented manual review; no chemical identifier is attributed to the USDA source.

moisture_basis: As-consumed standardized tea infusion: USDA states 1% (1g tea leaves/100ml boiling water) and reports values mg/100g (100ml) infusion; no further conversion applied

extraction_notes: USDA weighted table mean for the exact analyte label (-)-Epigallocatechin 3-gallate: 26.05 mg/100g (100ml) as-consumed standardized infusion; N=2; SE=0.69; range 25.36–26.73; confidence B. USDA documentation states tea infusions are standardized to 1% tea leaves and are reported per 100g (100ml) as consumed; flavan-3-ol gallate esters are reported under their compound names without glycoside-to-aglycone conversion. Source ref 272 is explicitly listed as Unilever Bestfoods North America unpublished data (2002); source-level analytical method/individual observations are unavailable here.
uncertainty_notes: Low N=2. Aggregate only; underlying proprietary/unpublished source record not retrieved and method could not be independently checked. Exposure applies only to the USDA-standardized 1% infusion basis; it does not predict a differently prepared home brew or dry tea-leaf dose.
